title: PolicyDecision
description: The boundary contract between the Freedom Decision Kernel (FDK) and AuthGate. FDK answers 'is this action legitimate?' and emits this object; AuthGate consumes it and runs its capability gate ONLY on an explicit ALLOW. The two products share this schema, not code. FDK is deterministic (categorical verdict), so there is intentionally NO 'confidence' field — DEFER already expresses 'unsure, ask a human'.

verdict.description: ALLOW = legitimate (proceed to AuthGate). DENY = illegitimate or any FDK error. DEFER = legitimate but a human must confirm. AuthGate executes ONLY on ALLOW.

action_id.description: Identifier of the action this verdict is about. AuthGate binds the decision to the action it executes: a verdict for action X must not authorise action Y.

actor.description: Name of the acting entity, for audit correlation.

axiom_trace.description: The property-rights axioms / forbidden flags that drove the verdict (e.g. ['A4', 'A7', 'FORBIDDEN(coercion)']). Empty for a clean ALLOW.

fail_closed.description: True iff FDK produced this verdict from an error path (malformed input, internal failure). AuthGate treats a fail_closed verdict as non-executable even if verdict=ALLOW.

fdk_version.description: FDK package version that produced the decision (provenance).
